QuestInfo.name: [Mini-game] What is Maple Monsteropoly?
QuestInfo.0:
Learn more about Maple Monsteropoly from the Mini-game Station.

#b#e<Maple Monsteropoly>#k#n
 - Players: 3
 - Limit: Up to 10 times a day
 - Required Level: Lv. 33+
 - Victory Requirements: Roll the dice to occupy monster tiles. The player that survives to the end wins.
 - Rewards: #i4310126##t4310126# / #i2432833##t2432833#

0.msg: Hee, hee, you must be here to talk about Monsteroply!

1.msg: OOPS! You stepped into a spot that belongs to me! Don't you know you shouldn't trespass? Now you have to pay the fine.

2.msg: The fine is... #r210,000,000,000 mesos#k! \r\nHee, hee, hee! I'm just messing with you. You should see the look on your face!

4.msg: But now you'll remember how terrible it is to invade someone else's property! After all, owning a lot of property is the #bshortcut to victory#k! \r\nDon't I make #b<Monsteropoly>#k sound fun?

5.msg: #b#e<Monsteropoly>#k#n\r\nPlayers: 3\rLimit: Up to 10 times a day\r Required Level: Lv. 33+\r Victory Requirements: Roll the dice, move to a monster space, and occupy it. The player to last until the end wins.\r\nRewards:  #i4310126# #t4310126# #i2432833# #t2432833#

yes.0: What do you say? Grab some dice and play with your friends... if you have any!\r\n#b(You can join the Monsteropoly wait list by talking to the Dice Admin.)#k
